instruction: Pull over behind the dark car directly ahead.
paraphrases: Stop behind the dark car in front of us.|Follow the dark car ahead and pull over behind it.

instruction: Pass the motorbike on the left, then stop near the white car on the right.
paraphrases: Go past the left-hand motorbike and pull over by the white car on the right.|After the motorbike, stop beside the right-hand white car.
What car is in front of us?|Identify the car directly ahead.
